pr.title: Use SHA-256 for export hash verification
pr.body:
## Description

Affects `IOExtensionsKt.md5Hash` in `app/src/main/java/com/philkes/notallyx/utils/IOExtensions.kt`.

Today, export verification hashes the source ZIP and reopened URI before comparing their bytes. I found these helpers used MD5, while the MessageDigest analysis rule accepts SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, SHA256, SHA384, and SHA512.

I changed the Context, File, and InputStream helpers to `sha256Hash` using SHA-256 and updated the export verification references, names, and messages. The streaming, null handling, retry flow, and byte comparison remain unchanged. I added tests confirming identical content produces equal digests, modified content produces different digests, and the standard "abc" test vector produces the published SHA-256 digest.

I found this while running the app under RVSec, a runtime checker for how apps use the Java crypto and TLS APIs.

I also added a test for it (`IOExtensionsTest.kt`). The project builds with this change (`:app:testDebugUnitTest`).

I'm a Computer Engineering student at the University of Brasília (UnB), working on a research project on Android app analysis. Happy to adjust this to the project's conventions.
